My Journey


Over the last six years, I have significantly upskilled myself in various areas, including solutions architecture, system management, and web development, while working at RTÉ. During this time, I’ve had the opportunity to lead and contribute to several impactful projects. I designed and implemented an overtime dashboard using Power BI, developed both a Recce Library app and a Vehicle Reservation app using Power Apps, and played a key role as the technical lead in the development and implementation of our 'Radio Booking System.'


These experiences have not only enhanced my technical expertise but also provided me with a deeper understanding of how to create solutions that drive business efficiency. The website you're currently visiting is a culmination of my recent work for the Front-End Web Development studio at UCD, showcasing my journey and growth as a web developer.
